s: According to the Gentlemen's Agreement, what was the ratio of Cabinet representation for Andhra and Telangana?

The Gentlemen's Agreement, signed in 1956 before the formation of Andhra Pradesh, was intended to safeguard the interests of the Telangana region after its merger with Andhra State. s: Which of the following is incorrect about Damodaram Sanjivayya?
o: He was never defeated in an election.
He was the second Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh.
He served as the President of the Indian National Congress.
Worked as a minister in Andhra Pradesh Government.
x:
Damodaram Sanjivayya was the second Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1960– 1962) and the first Dalit Chief Minister of any Indian State. He later became the President of the Indian National Congress (1962–1964) and also served as a Union Minister. The statement that he was never defeated in an election is incorrect, as he did suffer electoral defeats during his political career. Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).

s: Who was the first Dalit Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh?
x:
Damodaram Sanjivayya became the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh in 1960, making him the first Dalit Chief Minister not only of Andhra Pradesh but also of any Indian State. His achievements include:
• Served as Chief Minister (1960–1962)
• Became President of the Indian National Congress (1962–64)
• Later served as Union Labour Minister
• Worked extensively for labour welfare and social justice. His rise from a humble background to the highest political offices remains a landmark in Indian politics. Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).
Exam Note:
• First Dalit CM of India – Damodaram Sanjivayya
• INC President – 1962–64

s: During whose reign did N. T. Rama Rao establish the Telugu Desam Party?
x:
The Telugu Desam Party (TDP) was founded by Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao (N. T. Rama Rao) on 29 March 1982 with the objective of protecting Telugu self-respect (Telugu Atma Gauravam) and providing an alternative to the Congress Party. At the time of the party's formation, Bhavanam Venkatarami Reddy was the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh. He served as Chief Minister from 24 February 1982 to 20 September 1982. Within a short period of its formation, the Telugu Desam Party achieved a historic victory in the 1983 Andhra Pradesh Assembly Elections, bringing N. T. Rama Rao to power. Hence, the correct answer is Option (3).
Exam Note:
